searchText: <@!425279588009246720> <@!425274498732916736> <@!275684146658148352> Small correction to EIP-3670: It should list 0x48 (BASEFEE, EIP-3198) as a valid opcode. The Yellow Paper hasn't been updated to London yet. <@!275684146658148352> <@!425279588009246720> <@!425274498732916736> And EIP-3855 should say "base" for the gas cost of 2. "verylow" means 3 (at least in the Yellow Paper). Thanks! Fixed: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/4767 <@!583892532644151312> do you think we could consider something like 1 gas for it though? Our benchmarking showed it would be safe to go sub 1 gas for pushes, but <@!425274498732916736> can correct me next week. <@!425279588009246720> IMHO 2 gas for PUSH0 makes sense since it's the same for many opcodes like ADDRESS, CHAINID, POP, etc. 1 gas is used only for JUMPDEST. Fixed this too: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/4768 <@!583892532644151312> let me know if you find any other bug. We have an improved spec for 3540 which we'll try to push latest on Monday, but it doesn't change any rule, just tries to improve the description. all of PUSH, DUP should be 2
